newsitem.title: UK: Granada in 136.5 mln stg sale to Davis.
newsitem.headline: Granada in 136.5 mln stg sale to Davis.

text.p: UK motorway restaurants to rental television company Granada Group said on Thursday it was selling Spring Grove Services to Davis Service Group for 136.5 million stg.
The sale is conditional on Davis shareholder and regulatory approval. Davis said it was setting a one-for-three rights issue at 215 pence to raise 71.5 million stg to help pay for the deal.

Spring Grove, which mainly provides rental and cleaning services for workwear as well as washroom towels and mats to business customers in the UK, Ireland and Germany, made a pretax profit of 11.6 million stg in 1995 and has assets of about 53 million stg.

Davis, whose activities focus on textile maintenance services, site maintenance services and support services, is holding an extraordinary meeting on September 23 for shareholders to vote on the acquistion and the rights issue.

"The directors consider that the opportunity to strengthen the product and services range, to improve operating margins and to derive benefits from enhanced systems across the enlarged customer base, combined with the scope for operating synergies, create significant potential for earnings growth," said Neil Benson, Davis chairman.
